decisions.reason: The white-label test vinyl series fits the firm's existing strengths in physical collector formats and niche catalog retailing, so even limited first-year evidence is worth developing further because the firm can readily learn from customer response and refine the offer.

The German new wave compilation series is very close to the firm's curation, in-house label capabilities, and enthusiast customer base, making it a product the firm is well placed to improve and commercialize through its existing knowledge and channels.
